# Works of this genre the title's library holds (hashkafa); scope: title.
# 2026-11-10 (Daniel): each corpus volume counts on its own -- the Torah,
# the Prophets and the Writings are three works, each Bavli order one.
kehillah_lib_genre_3_held_count_value = {
	value = 0
	if = {
		limit = { is_target_in_variable_list = { name = kehillah_library_works target = flag:work_sefer_yetzirah } }
		add = { value = 1 }
	}
	if = {
		limit = { is_target_in_variable_list = { name = kehillah_library_works target = flag:work_hekhalot_rabbati } }
		add = { value = 1 }
	}
	if = {
		limit = { is_target_in_variable_list = { name = kehillah_library_works target = flag:work_shiur_qomah } }
		add = { value = 1 }
